notes: Prompt levels for library games. Sketch is the library prompt itself; Brief and Design doc are longer, original-world versions of the same game, written in the matching .md file.

levels.title: Lantern Burrow
levels.watchFor: Beetles all taking the same route; no patrol/hunt switching or no reversal at each switch; turns not buffered so cornering feels sticky; tunnel not wrapping; dazzle never ending or never flashing before it ends; the catch chain not doubling 200-400-800-1600; the maze changed from the given grid; numbers hard-coded instead of read from src/config.js.

levels.title: Lantern Burrow
levels.watchFor: A stage of the build order left half-done while a later one was started; beetles sharing one target rule; the mode table, nest release counts or difficulty table ignored; Rook's temper missing; no input buffering; collisions missed at speed (beetles passing through Pip); the mazes altered or only maze 1 used; no title, pause, game-over or initials screens; no sound; no ?debug target overlay.

levels.title: Coldiron Station
levels.watchFor: Movement along world axes instead of the view direction, or strafe/mouse turning reversed; speed or turning tied to frame rate; a grid raycaster instead of sectors with their own floor and ceiling heights; walls vanishing or showing through each other near corners (no per-column clipping or near-plane clip); stairs and the ledge drawn flat; the ledge reachable without the lift; collision that sticks instead of sliding; enemies drawn through walls; the level data changed instead of loaded as given.

levels.title: Coldiron Station
levels.watchFor: Any rule of the camera and movement section broken (axes, angle direction, strafe, mouse, frame-rate independence); a later build stage started while an earlier one is half-done; a raycaster instead of the portal renderer; untextured floors and ceilings; enemies with one view instead of 8; no infighting or splash damage; doors, lift, crusher, flicker or secret missing; only one level; no automap or split-screen; numbers hard-coded instead of read from src/config.js.
